create.name: Tony Brady
create.bio:
Tony Brady is a mindfulness teacher and writer living in Dublin. Raised a Catholic, he kept a lifelong interest in the spiritual life and in the 1990s, prompted by the writing of Jon Kabat-Zinn, began to practise meditation and study the Buddhist path. His teaching brings these strands together: Buddhist meditation and ethics, Christian contemplative prayer, Stoic thought and a little modern psychology, offered in a plain, gentle voice to people of any faith or none. He is wary of mindfulness reduced to a technique and speaks of it instead as a way of living, returning again and again to the present moment.

Since 2018 he has published a large body of short guided meditations and talks on Insight Timer, many of them morning practices, along with courses on gratitude, loving kindness, decluttering and caring for the earth. His recurring themes are gratitude, forgiveness, kindness and beginning again. He has written several small books of reflections and prayers, among them Just for Today, The Gratitude Response and A Wave of Blessing, and on his website Life of Mindfulness he posts a weekly thought and a hundred-word reflection with a meditation to go with it. Everything he shares online is free, and he asks anyone who wants to give something back to support a charity.

books.title: Just for Today: A Guide to Mindful Living Day by Day
books.author: Tony Brady
books.description: A book of short daily readings built around living one day at a time. Each entry suggests a small, decent act or attitude to practise, so that kindness becomes a habit.

books.title: The Gratitude Response
books.author: Tony Brady
books.description: A short book on gratitude as a daily practice. It invites the reader to notice the people and events that have supported them and to let thankfulness settle a restless mind.

books.title: Wave of Blessing and Other Meditations
books.author: Tony Brady
books.description: A collection of stand-alone meditations, reflections and blessings that can be read in any order. Topics include the pattern of a life and the way people arrive and depart over the years.

books.title: Simply Calling God: Reflections and Prayers for Life's Situations
books.author: Tony Brady
books.description: A small book of prayers, thanksgivings and blessings for ordinary moments and life stages, from family and friendship to change and loss. Written to be usable by readers of any faith or none.

books.title: 100 Words On...
books.author: Tony Brady
books.description: A month of brief daily readings, each about a hundred words long. Every day points to something ordinary that deserves a moment of wonder, as a simple 31-day practice of attention.

books.title: The Time of Your Life
books.author: Tony Brady
books.description: A compact guide to using time well, arranged in short themed chapters. It treats each hour as something to inhabit fully rather than rush through, and is meant for dipping into.

courses.title: Awakening To A Life Of Gratitude
courses.description: A multi-day Insight Timer course of short talks and guided practices on gratitude. It works through ways of noticing what sustains us and making thankfulness part of each day.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Live A Life Of Loving Kindness
courses.description: An Insight Timer course on loving kindness drawn from the Buddhist practice of metta. Each session pairs a reflection with a meditation that widens goodwill from oneself to others.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Tony Brady on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: A large library of short guided meditations and talks, many for the start of the day, on gratitude, kindness, forgiveness and letting things be. Free to listen to in the app or on the web.

free_resources.title: This Week: Thought, Reflection and Meditation
free_resources.description: A page on his site refreshed each week with a short theme, a hundred-word reflection and a linked meditation. It is meant to be read slowly and returned to during the week.
